name: Saeki Kanako
source: A pianist in the band formed with Kotori and Tomoko, as well as their best friend. This girl has special feelings for her brother, which sometimes turns into erotic fantasies. So it's not surprising that her nickname "Mikkun" comes from the name of her brother, Mikihiko.
